request.current_ask: Why is the debit card still not dispatched for this customer?

timeline.what: vendor rejected the address: pincode missing

root_cause.statement: The vendor rejected the dispatch because the address had no pincode, and no retry is scheduled after an address rejection.

scope.how_measured: count of dispatch requests in ADDRESS_REJECTED for this form

cx_answer.reply_text: The card was not dispatched because the delivery address was incomplete. We are fixing the address and will dispatch it again; no action is needed from the customer.

cx: Tell the customer the card will be dispatched again after the address fix.
eng: Add the pincode to the stored address, then trigger dispatch again.

suggested_fix.title: Trigger card dispatch again
preconditions: The stored address has a pincode.
suggested_fix.verify_with: SELECT status FROM card_dispatch_requests WHERE form_id = '8c1d2e3f-4a5b-4c6d-8e7f-9a0b1c2d3e02' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

suggested_fix.title: Check the stored address
suggested_fix.command: psql "$SSFB_RHYTHM_DB_URL" -c "SELECT pincode IS NOT NULL AS has_pincode FROM card_addresses WHERE form_id = '8c1d2e3f-4a5b-4c6d-8e7f-9a0b1c2d3e02'"

suggested_fix.title: Confirm the address with the customer
suggested_fix.command: Ask the customer to confirm the pincode in the app before the retry.
suggested_fix.verify_with: The address screen shows a pincode.

confidence_reason: the vendor rejection is in both the dispatch table and the service logs, and the code shows no retry after it
escalation_reasons: a write is needed to fix the address
